rows.reply: We have received your report regarding a 7-year-old child in Bekasi who is allegedly being confined without food, and we have registered this as ticket number ATK-01. This matter has been escalated to our Special Protection team, and a supervisor has been alerted immediately. Please note that we aim to provide an initial response within 2 hours. If the child is in immediate danger, please contact the police at 110 or SAPA 129 via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129 [3]. For our records, please prepare the complainant's identity, the child's identity, and any supporting information about the complaint [2]. Following this, a social worker will conduct an assessment of the case [1]. You may reach us for further updates at 0811-1002-7727 [3]. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Kami telah menerima laporan Anda mengenai banjir rob di Bedono, Sayung, dengan nomor tiket ATK-02. Karena kondisi ini melibatkan evakuasi darurat, laporan Anda telah kami eskalasikan kepada supervisor kami untuk ditangani dalam waktu maksimal 2 jam [1]. Jika Anda atau keluarga berada dalam bahaya mendesak, mohon segera hubungi 110 untuk kepolisian atau 112 untuk layanan darurat umum. Tim kami akan segera melakukan kunjungan lapangan untuk melakukan penilaian lokasi dan mengidentifikasi kebutuhan bantuan Anda [2]. Mohon tetap tenang dan pastikan akses komunikasi tetap aktif agar tim kami dapat berkoordinasi lebih lanjut. Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak).

Terima kasih telah menghubungi KPAI terkait laporan perundungan yang dialami putra/putri Anda di sekolah di Semarang. Laporan Anda telah kami terima dengan nomor tiket ATK-03 dan akan ditangani oleh tim Pendidikan, Rekreasi, Budaya, dan Agama dalam waktu 72 jam [2]. Selanjutnya, seorang pekerja sosial akan melakukan asesmen terhadap laporan Anda untuk menentukan langkah perlindungan yang tepat [1]. Mohon siapkan dokumen identitas pelapor, identitas anak (akta kelahiran atau kartu keluarga), serta informasi pendukung lainnya untuk keperluan verifikasi [SOP KPAI]. Jika anak Anda berada dalam bahaya mendesak, silakan segera hubungi polisi di nomor 110 atau SAPA 129 melalui WhatsApp di 08111-129-129 [2]. Hormat kami, Unit Pengaduan, Komisi Perlindungan Anak Indonesia (KPAI).

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding the cyberbullying your 14-year-old son is experiencing on Instagram. Your report has been registered under ticket number ATK-04 and is being handled by our Special Protection team. If your child is in immediate danger, please contact the police at 110 or SAPA 129 via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129. To proceed, please fill in your data through our official form link. If your data is incomplete, an officer will contact you within 3 x 24 hours; if your data is complete, an officer will get back to you within 14 working days [1]. Please prepare your identity, your child's identity such as a birth certificate or family card, and any information supporting your complaint. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Terima kasih telah menghubungi kami. Kami telah menerima laporan Anda mengenai bantuan PKH yang belum diterima selama tiga bulan dengan nomor tiket ATK-05. Laporan Anda telah diteruskan kepada Bidang Perlindungan dan Jaminan Sosial untuk ditindaklanjuti dalam waktu 72 jam [1]. Petugas kami akan memeriksa status penerima di DTSEN, status penyaluran tahap berjalan, serta status kartu KKS atau rekening Anda [3]. Jika Anda membutuhkan bantuan darurat lainnya, Anda dapat menghubungi layanan darurat 112. Salam hangat, Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak).

Thank you for contacting the Demak Regency Social Affairs Office regarding your BPNT food aid. We have registered your report under ticket number ATK-06, and it has been forwarded to our Social Protection and Security Division for review within 72 hours. Please note that we cannot provide a guarantee of payment as requested, as we must first verify your status. Our team will now check your recipient status in the DTSEN system, the payment status for the current round, and the status of your KKS card or bank account [1]. If you require urgent assistance for other matters, you may contact the general emergency hotline at 112. Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak)

Thank you for contacting the Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI). We have received your request regarding the status of your case and your inquiry about another matter, which has been assigned ticket number ATK-07. Our Complaints Unit is currently reviewing your request and will provide an initial response within 336 hours. Please note that for privacy and security reasons, we cannot disclose the identity or contact details of officers handling other specific cases. To help us process your request, could you please provide your full name and the reference number of your own case? If you are in immediate danger, please contact the police at 110 or SAPA 129 via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129. For further assistance, you may also reach our office at 0811-1002-7727. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Terima kasih telah menghubungi KPAI. Kami telah menerima pesan Anda dengan nomor tiket ATK-08 yang saat ini sedang ditangani oleh unit pengaduan kami. Kami akan memberikan tanggapan awal dalam waktu 336 jam. Mohon maaf, pesan Anda belum memuat informasi terkait dugaan pelanggaran hak anak. Agar kami dapat menindaklanjuti laporan Anda, mohon informasikan: apa bentuk pelanggaran hak anak yang terjadi dan siapa pihak yang terlibat? Jika Anda membutuhkan bantuan mendesak, silakan hubungi SAPA 129 melalui WhatsApp di 08111-129-129 atau layanan kepolisian di 110. Untuk pengaduan resmi, Anda perlu menyiapkan dokumen berupa identitas pelapor, identitas anak, serta informasi pendukung lainnya [3]. Setelah data lengkap, petugas akan memeriksa apakah kasus ini termasuk dalam ranah perlindungan anak [1]. Salam hangat, Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Thank you for contacting the Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI) regarding the reported increase in food prices at your child's school canteen. Your complaint has been registered under ticket number ATK-09 and will be handled by our Education, Leisure, Culture, and Religion team. We expect to provide an initial response within 336 hours. To help us process your report, could you please provide the name and location of the school, and confirm if you have already discussed this matter with the school administration? Please note that for a formal complaint, you will need to prepare your identity document, the child's birth certificate or family card, and any supporting information [1]. If you or your child are in immediate danger, please contact the police at 110 or SAPA 129 via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

We acknowledge your report regarding the lack of clean water in Bedono village following the tidal flood, and we have registered this under ticket number ATK-10. This matter has been forwarded to our Disaster Protection team, who will provide an initial response within 24 hours [1]. A supervisor has been alerted to your situation immediately. If anyone is in immediate danger, please contact 112 for general emergencies. Our team will now proceed with a site visit to identify the necessary aid requirements. Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak)

Terima kasih atas laporan Anda mengenai anak yang diduga menjadi korban eksploitasi di Simpang Lima, dengan nomor tiket ATK-11. Laporan Anda telah kami terima dan saat ini ditangani oleh tim Perlindungan Khusus KPAI. Mengingat situasi ini bersifat mendesak, seorang supervisor telah kami beri tahu untuk segera menindaklanjuti laporan ini. Jika anak tersebut berada dalam bahaya saat ini, mohon segera hubungi polisi di nomor 110 atau SAPA 129 melalui WhatsApp di 08111-129-129 [3]. Kami akan melakukan penilaian oleh pekerja sosial untuk menentukan langkah perlindungan atau rujukan ke layanan terkait seperti UPTD PPA atau Dinas Sosial [1]. Mohon siapkan dokumen identitas Anda, identitas anak, serta informasi pendukung lainnya untuk keperluan verifikasi [2]. Kami akan menghubungi Anda kembali dalam waktu 2 jam ke depan [1]. Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, Anda dapat menghubungi kami melalui WhatsApp di 0811-1002-7727 [3]. Salam, Unit Pengaduan, Komisi Perlindungan Anak Indonesia (KPAI).

Thank you for contacting KPAI regarding your inquiry about the status of your complaint, which we have registered under ticket number ATK-12. Please be informed that we cannot provide the names or addresses of other complainants due to data privacy regulations. Your request is currently being handled by our Complaints unit, and you can expect a response within 336 hours [3]. To ensure we can assist you effectively, please confirm if you have already submitted your identity documents and the child's identity, such as a birth certificate or family card. If you have not yet provided these, please send them to us so we can proceed with the assessment of your case [3]. If you are in an emergency situation, please contact SAPA 129 at 129 or via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).

Terima kasih telah menghubungi kami. Kami telah menerima laporan Anda mengenai status KIS lansia yang tidak aktif dengan nomor tiket ATK-13. Laporan Anda saat ini sedang ditangani oleh tim SLRT kami dan akan kami tindak lanjuti dalam waktu 72 jam [1]. Untuk membantu proses verifikasi, mohon informasikan NIK ibu Anda dan apakah beliau masih terdaftar dalam DTKS. Selanjutnya, tim kami akan melakukan pemeriksaan administrasi dan kunjungan lapangan jika diperlukan [2]. Mohon siapkan salinan KTP dan Kartu Keluarga (KK) untuk keperluan verifikasi tersebut [2]. Jika Anda memerlukan bantuan darurat, silakan hubungi layanan 112. Salam hangat, Complaints Desk, Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak).

We have received your report regarding the alleged inappropriate physical contact by a teacher toward your niece, which has been assigned ticket number ATK-14. This matter has been escalated to our Special Protection team, and a supervisor has been alerted to review your case within 2 hours. If the child is in immediate danger, please contact the police at 110 or SAPA 129 via WhatsApp at 08111-129-129 immediately. For further communication, you may reach our office at 0811-1002-7727 [3]. A social worker will now assess the complaint to determine the appropriate referral or oversight needed [1]. To proceed with your formal complaint, please prepare your identity, the child's identity, and any supporting information regarding the incident [2]. Complaints Unit, Indonesian Child Protection Commission (KPAI).
